α (often 5%, 1%). Probability of rejecting H₀ when it is true (Type I error).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Statistical Hypothesis Testing — a core area of A-Level Maths.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Statistical Hypothesis Testing brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Statistical Hypothesis Testing.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
